title: Order XXI Rule 58 — Adjudication of claims to attached property — CPC 1908

content.heading: Adjudication of claims to, or objections to attachment of, property
content.text: Where any claim is preferred to, or any objection is made to the attachment of, any property attached in execution of a decree on the ground that such property is not liable to such attachment, the Court shall proceed to adjudicate upon the claim or objection in accordance with the provisions herein contained. The claim or objection shall be adjudicated upon as if it were a claim in a suit.
